body: # Earnings. After a soft Nike quarter, we have a big decision to make on the stock. AeroVironment soars 28% on earnings beat, backlog grows to $1.2 billion. Deutsche: One sector to drive double-digit growth in European earnings. Why we like the stock. Micron says the AI party is far from over, but not all are celebrating. Micron stock jumps 15% as soaring prices from AI boom lead to quadrupling of revenue. Why FedEx is down after a strong quarter — and its impact on our stock rating. FedEx posts strong earnings results in last quarter with freight business. Oracle beats on earnings, but stock drops on plans to raise another $20 billion. Why we're raising our price target on Broadcom despite its post-earnings sell-off. CrowdStrike narrowly beats estimates on AI tailwinds, but stock falls 10%. We're upping our Palo Alto price target after strong earnings vanquish AI fears. Dell stock skyrockets 32% for its best day ever as AI server revenue soars.
